_about: One entry per v1 Kaggle training run. All use ml/kaggle/train/body.py; 'env' overrides its defaults (YOLO11s, imgsz 640, 50 epochs, patience 15, batch 32, seed 42, classes rdd4). Build with: python ml/kaggle/build_kernel.py --run <name>. Results go to ml/reports/<name>/ and ml/EXPERIMENTS.md. b0 (Atul, 11 Nov) predates this file; its record is ml/reports/b0_yolo11s_640/ and its Kaggle notebook.

_sources.data_v1: adarshjaiswal2234/infrascan-data-v1 (kernel output: India+US RDD2022, leak-free split; built by ml/kaggle/data_v1)
_sources.cmird: adarshjaiswal2234/infrascan-cmird-pothole (private dataset: 372 Indian pothole frames, train only; built by ml/data/prepare_cmird.py)

b1_yolo11s_640.what: clean baseline: b0 config on the data_v1 split

e1_imgsz736.what: image size 736 (India's native 720) for small potholes

e2_cmird_rdd4.what: b1 + CMIRD Indian pothole frames in train (frames that also show cracks skipped)
e2_cmird_rdd4.status: done 16 Nov 2026 (same as b1 within noise)

e4_yolo26s.what: newer model family, same size: YOLO26s instead of YOLO11s
e4_yolo26s.status: done 16 Nov 2026 (re-pushed with cache off after a RAM kill; 128 min). Beats all 3 b1 seeds on pothole AP50

e6_epochs100.what: b1 trained for 100 epochs instead of 50 (b1 was still improving at epoch 48-49); also the first run with the faster loader settings, so its seconds per epoch compare directly with b1's 120 s

e5_yolo11m.what: bigger model: YOLO11m instead of YOLO11s (batch 16 to fit T4 memory)

e7_yolo26s_cmird_holdout.what: e4 (YOLO26s) + CMIRD Indian motorbike frames in train, 7 CMIRD videos held out (every 3rd video by frame count, from the 2nd largest) to score on footage like real use. Compare with e4 on the same held-out frames
e7_yolo26s_cmird_holdout.status: done 18 Nov 2026 (2.05 h). Held-out videos: pothole AP50 0.08 -> 0.23 vs e4; RDD val same as e4 within noise
